pose_method: solvePnPGeneric IPPE_SQUARE on the 4 corners (full 6-DOF); two-lobe ambiguity by lobe separation: lobes >= 40.0 deg apart trust reprojection (sol0), near-degenerate lobes use outlier-gated continuity seeded by plumbness against the tabletop-derived gravity

tabletop.note: up_cam: SEED gravity from the plane fitted to the desk-marker depth annulus (authoritative gravity = wall marker in-plane up, calibrate_scene.py). point_desk_cam: tabletop point at the desk marker. point_obj_cam: tabletop point AT THE OBJECT (cube height reference), only when the object annulus agreed with the desk plane (box resting, not held); camera frame

coordinate_frame: camera (color): X right, Y down, Z forward, meters; R,t map marker-frame points into the camera frame
